verdict.rationale: Ramp provides multiple AI automations directly relevant to closing books faster: auto-categorized receipts, invoice-to-payment automation with GL coding, real-time bidirectional ERP sync eliminating manual journal entries, and customer testimonials citing faster onboarding/consolidation. These directly support faster month-end close workflows for accounting-integrations-focused users. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of close-time reduction and no explicit case study quantifying days-to-close improvement.
